description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams' used for filtering employee dependents in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties for employee number, name, and relationship type, along with corresponding getters and setters. The class also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee dependents with properties for employee number, name, and relationship type, including default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'd.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type filter criterion.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type filter criterion.
